lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，身子拉得很长。
lines.en: I keep low to the ground with my body drawn long.

lines.zh: 我一路闻着树根，往前走。
lines.en: I move along, sniffing every root.
I go quickly in small steps.

lines.zh: 我从树干上滑下来，落在草里。
lines.en: I slide down a trunk and land in the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着树走了一圈，又往前走。
lines.en: I circle a tree once, then move on.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴垂在身后，轻轻摆。
lines.en: My tail hangs behind me, swaying.

lines.zh: 我穿过灌木，叶子抖了一路。
lines.en: I push through the brush and leaves shake.

lines.zh: 我朝着有味道的方向去。
lines.en: I head for the direction with the smell.

lines.zh: 我钻进一条窄小的兽径。
lines.en: I slip into a narrow game trail.

lines.zh: 我爬上一段倒木，再跳下去。
lines.en: I climb a fallen log and drop off.

lines.zh: 我走路的样子像在溜，不像在跑。
lines.en: I move like I am slinking, not running.

lines.zh: 我坐在树杈上，看着下面。
lines.en: I sit on a fork of branches and watch below.

lines.zh: 我的头左右摆，一直在听。
lines.en: My head swings side to side, always listening.

lines.zh: 我把身子团起来，很省力。
lines.en: I curl up; it costs less effort.
My fur shines in the light.

lines.zh: 这一片的味道我都记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the smells here.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只前爪，舔了两下。
lines.en: I lift a forepaw and lick it twice.

lines.zh: 我藏在叶子里，你看不见。
lines.en: I am hidden in the leaves; you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我在等一个合适的机会。
lines.en: I am waiting for the right moment.
The birds in the wood keep calling.
I shift one branch higher.

lines.zh: 这里没有我喜欢的气味。
lines.en: There is no smell here that I like.
I lie along the branch, tail hanging.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，像一段树皮。
lines.en: Still, I look like a strip of bark.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我已经不动了。
lines.en: When you look up, I am already still.
I tilt my head and size you up.

lines.zh: 树上的果子，比你的手快。
lines.en: I reach the fruit faster than you.
I crouch a little lower.
You are standing under my tree.
The tip of my tail is moving.
Are you coming up the tree?

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，没有下树。
lines.en: I watch you a long time without coming down.

lines.zh: 我踩了踩树枝，试它牢不牢。
lines.en: I test the branch with my weight.
You cannot see me well.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一段，又停住。
lines.en: I edge forward, then stop.
Your eyes are searching for me.

lines.zh: 我偏了偏头，跳到了另一边。
lines.en: I cock my head and jump to the other side.
Keep staring and I'll take the tree.

lines.zh: 我就在这儿，你要怎么办。
lines.en: I am right here; what will you do?
My claws dig into the bark.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我就换一根枝。
lines.en: You take a step, and I change branches.
I shriek and bolt up the tree.
I flatten down and back away.
I have gone behind the tree.
I've carved that hit into my scales.
I curl up and watch you.

lines.zh: 血的味道让林子安静了。
lines.en: The smell of blood quiets the wood.
I start climbing higher.

lines.zh: 吱！森林里跑得快才算本事。
lines.en: Squeak! In this forest, speed is everything.
I know that smell; it is meat.
I have come down the tree.
I close in cautiously, testing each step.
Give me what you are holding.
I stretch my neck to sniff it.
I circle you, looking for a chance.

lines.zh: 你要是松手，我就拿走了。
lines.en: If you let go, I will take it.

lines.zh: 我吃得很小心，会看着你。
lines.en: I eat warily, keeping an eye on you.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我一窜就上了树。
lines.en: You touch me and I bolt up the tree.
The knock turns me aside.
I am light; a knock does not hurt.
I weave past your leg.
I hit the ground and scramble up.
I went tense all at once.
I retreat toward the tree.
Do not edge in this way.
My fur prickles a little.
I crouch and move away.
I made two rounds around it.

lines.zh: 这段时间我们总在一起。
lines.en: In these days we stay together.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一个树洞边。
lines.en: We crowd at the same hollow.
I rest my head against its shoulder.

lines.zh: 平时我一个人走，现在不是。
lines.en: Usually I travel alone; not now.
We climb the tree, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 林子这么大，我们只找彼此。
lines.en: The wood is vast, and we look only for each other.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴和它的缠在一起。
lines.en: Our tails twine together.
I take it and spring up the tree.
I pin it with both forepaws.
This is not something to eat.
I carry it a few steps off.
It slips out of my mouth.
Too hard to bite.
I hold it and hesitate.
I climb faster than you walk.
I go suddenly still.
I heard it, and you saw me hear.
I have come down from the tree.
I drop low and head that way.
This one is smaller than me.
I could give that a try.
I circle it without hurrying.
I stop a short distance off.
I have picked my angle.
I can strike from the tree too.
It went that way; I follow.
I work around behind it.
I follow along the branches.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿我都看得见。
lines.en: I can see wherever you go.
I stay above you.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我正好在阴影里。
lines.en: You look up, and I am in the shade.
I drop down and close in.
I am patient; I wait for it to tire.

lines.zh: 它绕了一圈，又回到原地。
lines.en: It circled and came back to the same spot.

lines.zh: 我的步子几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My steps make almost no sound.

lines.zh: 我换到另一条道上截它。
lines.en: I take another trail to cut it off.
I crouch and move along the grass.

lines.zh: 这一圈我已经收得很紧了。
lines.en: I have drawn the ring tight.
I stop only to change my angle.
I am waiting for its back to turn.
The path through the trees is shorter.
For the last stretch, I run.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，两只前爪一起按。
lines.en: I pounce and pin with both forepaws.
I dart in from the side and bite.
That landed on the leg.
I bite, then pull back to watch.
It thrashes, and I do not let go.
One paw down, and I don't let go.
That bite missed.

lines.zh: 我的爪子再抓，对准脖子。
lines.en: My claws again, aimed at the throat.

lines.zh: 一咬下去，血溅到我胸口。
lines.en: One bite sprays blood on my chest.
I spring off its back.
It can still move; I go again.
After the bite I run for the tree.

lines.zh: 树杈上忽然多了一个影子。
lines.en: A shape appears on the branch.
The hollow was tight; I squeezed out.
The grass stirs, and it is me.
I slide down the trunk.

lines.zh: 这一带的气味，我要重新闻一遍。
lines.en: I need to learn the scents here.
I stand on a branch and look below.
I sniff the ground first.

lines.zh: 林子边上多了一双眼睛。
lines.en: There is another pair of eyes at the treeline.
My claws touch down first.
I have landed, silently.

lines.zh: 我绕着这棵树走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle this tree once.
I look up into the canopy.
I have found a good branch.
I settle down to observe.
I smelled you from far off.
I am here; do not move.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我在地上滚了两圈。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur; I roll twice on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从枝上摔下来，摔得很实。
lines.en: I fall from the branch and land hard.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从树上掀下去。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the tree.
Some force pins me to the branch.
Hunger leaves me too weak to climb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有枝，我抓不到东西。
lines.en: There is no branch and nothing to catch.
